CLI: RUN_LOGS_PRESERVED / RUN_LOGS_REFUSED / WORKTREE_REMOVED / WORKTREE_REFUSED with exits 0/1/0/2. Plus the 13-case jest pin.

nonClaims: NOTHING CALLS THIS HELPER YET. The proof scripts and the lane cleanup are U17's (council 2 section D item 3); package.json is untouched by this unit and no npm script runs the CLI. Until U17 lands, a worktree removal that skips a hand-run of this CLI still loses its logs exactly as U3's were lost.

The preserved copies are local and gitignored (.gitignore line 189 `.sisyphus/*`). Only the manifest in openspec/planning/2026-09-12-roadmap-completion/evidence/ is committed. The bytes survive a worktree removal, not a machine loss.

No claim that this enforces every clause of DELIVERY.md's owned-cleanup paragraph. The allowed ignored/untracked manifest is NOT implemented: `git worktree remove --force` is used (after the HEAD, clean-state and listing checks pass) because a proof worktree legitimately carries ignored artefacts, so an unexpected ignored file is not itself refused.
No claim about branch deletion. The helper removes and prunes a worktree; compare-guarded branch deletion is not implemented here.

No claim that the CLI's removal half was exercised against a program worktree. Every real `git worktree remove` in this lane ran in a temporary repository created by the pin; the one CLI removal invocation aimed at a path that does not exist and refused with WORKTREE_MISSING before any git call.
No build and no Playwright run was performed, so nothing here is evidence about the application.
The `onCopied` and `git` parameters are pin-only injection points. They have no CLI flag and their defaults do the real thing, but they are not a tested production surface.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: The product file is 410 lines against the admission estimate of 180-240. The excess is largely oxfmt's call-wrapping: each typed refusal becomes a five-line `throw new XError(code, message)`, and there are fourteen of them. It is inside the unit's 500-line cap on non-generated product lines but 70% above the estimate, so the estimate, not the cap, was wrong.
findingsReportedNotFixed.notFixedBecause: the alternative is a throw-wrapping helper that saves about a line per site and hides the throw from static reading; that trade was judged worse than the line count.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: The helper refuses only when the run directory's LAST component is a reparse point (fs.lstatSync(runDir).isSymbolicLink()). A run directory whose ANCESTOR is a junction is preserved rather than refused.
findingsReportedNotFixed.notFixedBecause: the charter scopes the refusal to 'runDir itself', and an ancestor check by canonical-path comparison was measured to be fragile on Windows (the system temp directory can resolve through a short path, which would make legitimate runs refuse). Recorded so a later unit can widen it deliberately.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: A manifest whose preserved copies live on a different drive from the repository root cannot be written: path.relative returns an absolute path across drives, and the helper refuses with RUN_DIR_OUTSIDE_ROOT / PRESERVED_DIR_OUTSIDE_ROOT rather than putting an absolute machine path in evidence. That is deliberate, but it means the CLI cannot be pointed at a system temp directory on this machine (temp is on C:, the repository on E:).
findingsReportedNotFixed.notFixedBecause: 'relative to the repository root, never absolute' is the manifest contract; loosening it to allow an absolute fallback would put machine paths into committed evidence. The pin passes an explicit repoRoot for its temp scaffolds and the real CLI probe used a directory inside the worktree for the same reason.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: Under M3 the removal still reported success while leaving the worktree directory in place: after the junction's target was destroyed the dangling junction remained inside the worktree, `git worktree remove --force` exited 0, and the directory survived. The helper does not verify after the removal that the directory is gone.
findingsReportedNotFixed.notFixedBecause: out of this unit's behaviour sentence. Recorded for U17's callers, which could assert the directory's absence after the CLI returns WORKTREE_REMOVED.
